description:
Following an unfortunate episode of mental illness, Alma is sent to a cottage in the countryside where she finds peace tending to the overgrown garden. However, while admiring the large ivy growing across its fence, she discovers a leaf bearing a single written word - hello. Her father and caregiver brush it off as nothing but a hallucination, a symptom of her hysteria

But now Alma must face the very real struggle of making herself heard and respected in male-dominated Victorian England. Can you help Alma find her power and solve this dangerous mystery before it's too late?

• Enjoy beautifully illustrated backgrounds and expressive character portraits!
• Navigate a deep narrative about mental health and female empowerment.
• Discover a detailed world set in Victorian England!
• Make key choices and explore multiple endings.
• Immerse yourself in a story of 14,000 written words and an evocative original soundtrack!
name: Secrets In Green
intro: If Mother Nature spoke to you, would you listen and perhaps discover a power growing inside yourself?
